item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00303","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C05","C10","C21"],"selected_candidate_label":"C05","confidence":0.96,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C05 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both letters open by praising departmental performance under the recipient's leadership, immediately accept a resignation effective January 20, 1961, commend the recipient and staff, summarize selected departmental accomplishments attributed to the recipient's report, and close with appreciation plus wishes for health and happiness upon leaving government service. The closely matching language and provision sequence exceed generic resignation-letter boilerplate. C10 and C21 share much of the same machinery, but C05 has the closest combined wording and structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"through the broad programs administered by the Department of Health, Education and Welfare under your leadership","parent_excerpt":"Under your leadership, the Department of Commerce has continued to be an articulate and effective voice","explanation":"Both begin by framing the department's achievements as the result of the departing secretary's leadership."},{"child_excerpt":"In accepting your resignation, effective January 20, 1961, I wish to express my deep appreciation to you and your able staff.","parent_excerpt":"In accepting your resignation as Secretary of Commerce, effective January 20, 1961, I take the opportunity to pay tribute to you and your excellent staff.","explanation":"This is a close sentence-level template with the same operative act, effective date, appreciation formula, and commendation of the staff."},{"child_excerpt":"On all fronts great gains have been made ... As your report indicates, medical research and health facilities have been significantly expanded","parent_excerpt":"Among the many significant accomplishments of your Department these past eight years ... As you point out in your report","explanation":"Both pivot from accepting the resignation to a report-based inventory of major departmental accomplishments."},{"child_excerpt":"As you return to private life, I wish you a future of good health and happiness.","parent_excerpt":"As you leave government service, I wish you health and happiness in the years to come.","explanation":"The closing uses substantially the same departure and future-well-wishes formula."}]}
